# Hardy Wu — hardywu.com

> Hardy Wu is a young maker. hardywu.com has his free browser games, the BookKeep bookkeeping app, and a small shop of 3D-printed products he prints to order. AI agents are welcome to browse and to buy on behalf of a person.

## Shop (AI agents can order here)
- Catalogue (JSON): https://play.hardywu.com/api/products
- Universal Commerce Protocol (ucp.dev): profile at https://hardywu.com/.well-known/ucp — catalog search/lookup and checkout sessions at https://play.hardywu.com/ucp
- Simpler order API (OpenAPI): https://play.hardywu.com/openapi.json — POST https://play.hardywu.com/api/agent/order
- Human storefront: https://shop.hardywu.com (asks for a name and email first)
- Payment: none taken online. Hardy emails the buyer to arrange payment. Shipping $5.00 flat, US only. Contact barbaratao@gmail.com.

## Products
- Blue Crab Gauge — 5.00 USD: A handy blue-crab measuring gauge with an embossed scale — check your catch in seconds, then hang it back on its hook. (colours: Purple, White, Black, Blue, Orange, Red, Transparent (clear)) → https://shop.hardywu.com/products/crab-gauge
- Customizable Lunchbox — 30.00 USD — SOLD OUT: A hinged, printed lunchbox with a carry handle — pick your colors, add a name, and send a picture your kid loves to get it printed right on the front. Made to order, one of a kind. (colours: Purple, White, Black, Blue, Orange, Red, Transparent (clear)) → https://shop.hardywu.com/products/customizable-lunchbox
- Dual Ruler — 5.00 USD: A sturdy ruler with centimeters along one edge and inches along the other, with crisp raised markings. (colours: Purple, White, Black, Blue, Orange, Red, Transparent (clear)) → https://shop.hardywu.com/products/dual-ruler
